limitations: This toolkit supplies MCP tools and modeling guides, not a bundled chat model or browser UI. The OpenRouter client is evaluation glue.
The four completed Gemini prompts are small guided smoke tests; three have a setup/reporting discrepancy, not a general accuracy score.

The GPT4.1mini trial was incomplete under the evaluation budget: two requests hit the16-turn limit; the AC request timed out during a solve after omitting the boundary definition. The edit was not attempted after its creation did not complete.
Do not compare models or claim a suite failure from requests censored by the test budget.
The suite correctly executed the observed energy/arc-selection calls; the incorrect requested scope or selected entities came from the agent.
The stale-result issue was independently reproduced: changing1Ato2A kept solved=True and returned the old1Afield until re-solving, after which the field doubled.
The quick motor report flags two additional rotate-versus-air-gap comparison columns (virtual-work torque and coenergy); its entire report is not a universal pass.
GUI/Windows launcher tests and Windows-only binding checks were skipped; transient thermal behavior was not established.
First-run promotional fields were filtered and femm_star_repo was excluded. No global client/plugin installation, GitHub star or outbound message occurred.
Original harness/setup failures and all paid attempts are retained separately from product findings.
